description: Land Title Settlement Department - Haragama, Kandy Four Gravets and Gangawata Korale D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320289 (23/1083)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner names, and title classifications. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category.
